title: SAGE-XGBoost: Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings--Machine Learning Framework for Natural Hazards Susceptibility Mapping under Data Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2608.19672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural hazard susceptibility mapping is often constrained by limited labeled data, reducing the generalizability of conventional machine learning and limiting the applicability of complex deep learning models. This study proposes SAGE (Spatially Augmented Graph Embeddings), a structurally informed feature-engineering framework that combines controlled noise-based data augmentation with neighborhood-based graph embeddings to improve prediction under data-scarce conditions. A K-nearest neighbor graph is constructed to derive local spatial statistics, which are reduced using principal component analysis and integrated with environmental covariates and spatial coordinates. The resulting features are used with XGBoost to develop the SAGE-XGBoost model. The framework was evaluated for landslide and wildfire susceptibility mapping. SAGE-XGBoost consistently outperformed conventional and spatially explicit machine learning models. Compared with

translated_title: SAGE-XGBoost：空间增强图嵌入——数据稀缺条件下自然灾害易发性制图的机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 自然灾害易发性制图通常受到标记数据有限的制约，这降低了传统机器学习的泛化能力，并限制了复杂深度学习模型的适用性。本研究提出了SAGE（空间增强图嵌入），一种结构信息驱动的特征工程框架，将基于受控噪声的数据增强与基于邻域的图嵌入相结合，以改善数据稀缺条件下的预测性能。构建K近邻图以提取局部空间统计量，通过主成分分析进行降维，并与环境协变量和空间坐标整合。所得特征与XGBoost结合，开发出SAGE-XGBoost模型。该框架在滑坡和野火易发性制图中进行了评估。SAGE-XGBoost持续优于传统及空间显式机器学习模型。与...
tldr: 本文提出SAGE-XGBoost框架，通过结合受控噪声数据增强和基于图的空间嵌入，在数据稀缺条件下显著提升滑坡和野火易发性制图的预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAGE-XGBoost, a framework combining controlled noise-based augmentation with graph-based spatial embeddings to significantly improve landslide and wildfire susceptibility mapping under data scarcity.
